Trump has a 45% approval rating in Mississippi, according to Aug. 31 polling data from Civiqs. That's the lowest ever for the state.

His disapproval rating is 49%, which is also the highest for both terms. About 6% neither approve nor disapprove.

Trump started this term in 2025 with about a 56% approval rating in the Magnolia State. About 41% disapproved. Both groups basically mirrored each other for most of his second term, inching closer and closer together over time. With two months to go until Americans vote in the 2026 midterm elections, new polling shows President Donald Trump facing a political landscape that has deteriorated significantly since the start of his second term.

The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. [...] That clustering suggests a map where small movements could quickly change the status of several states.

The broader partisan geography remains familiar. The margins, however, have narrowed considerably.
